sections.text_helper: Section 30.7 "Hardware flow control" in chapter 30 (Secure digital input/output MultiMediaCard interface (SDMMC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1424.
sections.section_content:
There are two hardware flow control mechanisms:
1. Hardware flow control during data transfer:
– Only to be used with cycle-aligned data transfers.
2. Block gap hardware flow control:
– Only used in mode with bus speed SDR50, SDR104, HS200 and DDR50.
– Must be used with variable delay.
